name: Quixel Megascans library (free again on Fab)
summary: Epic/Quixel says the full Megascans library of photoscanned 3D assets, surfaces and decals is going free again on Fab, with AI-training use allowed under new terms. Anyone who bought Megascans since Jan 1, 2025 gets a refund to their Epic balance. Listings are switching to free gradually until Nov 12, 2026.

access.price: $0 announced (gradual rollout until Nov 12, 2026; price per listing not confirmed)
access.notes: Needs an Epic account. Fab license: commercial use OK, no credit, no resale. AI-training clause not found in EULA text. HOLD until after Nov 12: confirm $0 per listing, the AI clause and a real image.

procedure: Sign in to fab.com with an Epic account.
Open the Quixel Megascans seller page and add free listings to your library.
Download, or use them in Unreal / Bridge.

verdict.why: Huge, high-quality official library that's free again, with commercial use. HELD: free rollout runs until Nov 12, $0 per listing and the AI-training clause aren't confirmed, Fab returns 403 to curl, and the only image is a logo.
